Answer: B
Reason: The CT images (specifically Figure 2a and 2b) demonstrate predominant micronodular lesions in the right upper and middle lobes, along with a distinct fibrotic focus in the left upper lobe. This pattern of apical fibrosis combined with nodular disease is characteristic of reactivation pulmonary tuberculosis, distinguishing it from the uniform distribution of classic miliary TB or other options.
